name: Audit General Ledger Query
query:
SELECT
  t.posting_date AS `Posting Date:Date:100`,
  t.account AS `Account:Link/Account:200`,
  CASE t.seq WHEN 2 THEN SUM(IF(t.seq = 1, t.debit, 0)) OVER () WHEN 3 THEN SUM(IF(t.seq IN (0, 1), t.debit, 0)) OVER () ELSE t.debit END AS `Debit:Currency:120`,
  CASE t.seq WHEN 2 THEN SUM(IF(t.seq = 1, t.credit, 0)) OVER () WHEN 3 THEN SUM(IF(t.seq IN (0, 1), t.credit, 0)) OVER () ELSE t.credit END AS `Credit:Currency:120`,
  SUM(IF(t.seq IN (0, 1), t.debit - t.credit, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY t.seq, t.posting_date, t.gl_creation, t.gl_name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `Balance:Currency:130`,
  t.voucher_type AS `Voucher Type:Link/DocType:130`,
  t.voucher_subtype AS `Voucher Subtype:Data:120`,
  t.voucher_no AS `Voucher No:Dynamic Link/voucher_type:170`,
  t.against AS `Against Account:Data:150`,
  t.party_type AS `Party Type:Link/DocType:100`,
  t.party AS `Party:Dynamic Link/party_type:150`,
  t.project AS `Project:Link/Project:110`,
  t.cost_center AS `Cost Center:Link/Cost Center:140`,
  t.against_voucher_type AS `Against Voucher Type:Link/DocType:130`,
  t.against_voucher AS `Against Voucher:Dynamic Link/against_voucher_type:160`,
  t.remarks AS `Remarks:Data:200`,
  IF(%(show_submitted)s = 1, t.doc_status, NULL) AS `Document Status:Data:110`,
  IF(%(show_created_by)s = 1, t.created_by, NULL) AS `Created By:Link/User:160`,
  IF(%(show_created_on)s = 1, t.created_on, NULL) AS `Created On:Datetime:160`,
  IF(%(show_modified_by)s = 1, t.modified_by, NULL) AS `Modified By:Link/User:160`,
  IF(%(show_modified_on)s = 1, t.modified_on, NULL) AS `Modified On:Datetime:160`,
  IF(%(show_submitted)s = 1, t.submitted_by, NULL) AS `Submitted By:Link/User:160`,
  IF(%(show_submitted)s = 1, t.submitted_on, NULL) AS `Submitted On:Datetime:160`,
  IF(%(show_cancelled_info)s = 1, t.cancelled_by, NULL) AS `Cancelled By:Link/User:160`,
  IF(%(show_cancelled_info)s = 1, t.cancelled_on, NULL) AS `Cancelled On:Datetime:160`,
  IF(%(show_gl_audit)s = 1, t.gl_posted_by, NULL) AS `GL Posted By:Link/User:160`,
  IF(%(show_gl_audit)s = 1, t.gl_posted_on, NULL) AS `GL Posted On:Datetime:160`,
  IF(%(show_activity)s = 1, t.activity, NULL) AS `Complete Activity:Data:330`,
  IF(%(show_activity)s = 1, t.activity_events, NULL) AS `Activity Events:Int:110`,
  IF(%(show_activity)s = 1, t.edits_after_submit, NULL) AS `Edits After Submit:Int:130`,
  IF(%(show_activity)s = 1, t.last_activity_by, NULL) AS `Last Activity By:Link/User:160`,
  IF(%(show_activity)s = 1, t.last_activity_on, NULL) AS `Last Activity On:Datetime:160`
FROM (
  /* 0: opening balance */
  SELECT 0 AS seq, %(from_date)s AS posting_date, NULL AS gl_creation, NULL AS gl_name, '''Opening''' AS account, IFNULL(SUM(gle.debit), 0) AS debit, IFNULL(SUM(gle.credit), 0) AS credit, NULL AS voucher_type, NULL AS voucher_subtype, NULL AS voucher_no, NULL AS against, NULL AS party_type, NULL AS party, NULL AS cost_center, NULL AS project, NULL AS against_voucher_type, NULL AS against_voucher, NULL AS remarks, NULL AS doc_status, NULL AS created_by, NULL AS created_on, NULL AS modified_by, NULL AS modified_on, NULL AS submitted_by, NULL AS submitted_on, NULL AS cancelled_by, NULL AS cancelled_on, NULL AS gl_posted_by, NULL AS gl_posted_on, NULL AS activity, NULL AS activity_events, NULL AS edits_after_submit, NULL AS last_activity_by, NULL AS last_activity_on
  FROM `tabGL Entry` gle
  WHERE gle.company = %(company)s
      AND (%(finance_book)s = '' OR IFNULL(gle.finance_book, '') IN ('', %(finance_book)s))
      AND (%(account)s = '' OR gle.account IN (
            SELECT ca.name FROM `tabAccount` ca, `tabAccount` pa
            WHERE pa.name = %(account)s AND ca.lft >= pa.lft AND ca.rgt <= pa.rgt))
      AND (%(voucher_type)s = '' OR gle.voucher_type = %(voucher_type)s)
      AND (%(voucher_no)s = '' OR gle.voucher_no = %(voucher_no)s)
      AND (%(party_type)s = '' OR gle.party_type = %(party_type)s)
      AND (%(party)s = '' OR gle.party = %(party)s)
      AND (%(cost_center)s = '' OR gle.cost_center IN (
            SELECT cc.name FROM `tabCost Center` cc, `tabCost Center` pc
            WHERE pc.name = %(cost_center)s AND cc.lft >= pc.lft AND cc.rgt <= pc.rgt))
      AND (%(project)s = '' OR gle.project = %(project)s)
      AND (%(show_cancelled_entries)s = 1 OR gle.is_cancelled = 0)
    AND (gle.posting_date < %(from_date)s OR (IFNULL(gle.is_opening, 'No') = 'Yes' AND gle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s))

  UNION ALL

  /* 1: period transactions with audit trail */
  SELECT 1 AS seq, x.posting_date AS posting_date, x.gl_creation AS gl_creation, x.gl_name AS gl_name, x.account AS account, x.debit AS debit, x.credit AS credit, x.voucher_type AS voucher_type, x.voucher_subtype AS voucher_subtype, x.voucher_no AS voucher_no, x.against AS against, x.party_type AS party_type, x.party AS party, x.cost_center AS cost_center, x.project AS project, x.against_voucher_type AS against_voucher_type, x.against_voucher AS against_voucher, x.remarks AS remarks, CASE x.docstatus WHEN 0 THEN 'Draft' WHEN 1 THEN 'Submitted' WHEN 2 THEN 'Cancelled' END AS doc_status, x.created_by AS created_by, x.created_on AS created_on, x.modified_by AS modified_by, x.modified_on AS modified_on, IF(x.docstatus IN (1, 2), x.submitted_by, NULL) AS submitted_by, IF(x.docstatus IN (1, 2), x.submitted_on, NULL) AS submitted_on, IF(x.docstatus = 2, COALESCE(x.cancelled_by_v, x.modified_by), NULL) AS cancelled_by, IF(x.docstatus = 2, COALESCE(x.cancelled_on_v, x.modified_on), NULL) AS cancelled_on, x.gl_posted_by AS gl_posted_by, x.gl_posted_on AS gl_posted_on, CONCAT_WS(' → ', 'Created', IF(x.draft_edits > 0, CONCAT(x.draft_edits, ' draft edit(s)'), NULL), IF(x.docstatus IN (1, 2), 'Submitted', NULL), IF(x.post_submit_edits > 0, CONCAT(x.post_submit_edits, ' edit(s) after submit'), NULL), IF(x.docstatus = 2, 'Cancelled', NULL), IF(x.comment_count > 0, CONCAT(x.comment_count, ' comment(s)'), NULL)) AS activity, 1 + x.version_count + x.comment_events AS activity_events, x.post_submit_edits AS edits_after_submit, CASE GREATEST(IFNULL(x.modified_on, '1900-01-01'), IFNULL(x.last_version_on, '1900-01-01'), IFNULL(x.last_comment_on, '1900-01-01')) WHEN IFNULL(x.last_comment_on, '1900-01-01') THEN x.last_comment_by WHEN IFNULL(x.last_version_on, '1900-01-01') THEN x.last_version_by ELSE x.modified_by END AS last_activity_by, GREATEST(IFNULL(x.modified_on, '1900-01-01'), IFNULL(x.last_version_on, '1900-01-01'), IFNULL(x.last_comment_on, '1900-01-01')) AS last_activity_on
  FROM (
    SELECT
      gle.posting_date, gle.creation AS gl_creation, gle.name AS gl_name, gle.account,
      gle.debit, gle.credit, gle.voucher_type, gle.voucher_subtype, gle.voucher_no, gle.against,
      gle.party_type, gle.party, gle.cost_center, gle.project,
      gle.against_voucher_type, gle.against_voucher, gle.remarks,
      COALESCE(je.docstatus, si.docstatus, pi.docstatus, pe.docstatus, pr.docstatus, dn.docstatus, ste.docstatus, sr.docstatus, lcv.docstatus, pcv.docstatus, err.docstatus, scr.docstatus, IF(gle.is_cancelled = 1, 2, 1)) AS docstatus,
      COALESCE(je.owner, si.owner, pi.owner, pe.owner, pr.owner, dn.owner, ste.owner, sr.owner, lcv.owner, pcv.owner, err.owner, scr.owner, gle.owner) AS created_by,
      COALESCE(je.creation, si.creation, pi.creation, pe.creation, pr.creation, dn.creation, ste.creation, sr.creation, lcv.creation, pcv.creation, err.creation, scr.creation, gle.creation) AS created_on,
      COALESCE(je.modified_by, si.modified_by, pi.modified_by, pe.modified_by, pr.modified_by, dn.modified_by, ste.modified_by, sr.modified_by, lcv.modified_by, pcv.modified_by, err.modified_by, scr.modified_by, gle.modified_by) AS modified_by,
      COALESCE(je.modified, si.modified, pi.modified, pe.modified, pr.modified, dn.modified, ste.modified, sr.modified, lcv.modified, pcv.modified, err.modified, scr.modified, gle.modified) AS modified_on,
      va.submitted_by, va.submitted_on,
      va.cancelled_by_v, va.cancelled_on_v,
      gle.owner AS gl_posted_by, gle.creation AS gl_posted_on,
      IFNULL(va.version_count, 0) AS version_count,
      IFNULL(va.comment_events, 0) AS comment_events,
      IFNULL(va.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count,
      IFNULL(va.draft_edits, 0) AS draft_edits,
      IFNULL(va.post_submit_edits, 0) AS post_submit_edits,
      va.last_version_on, va.last_version_by, va.last_comment_on, va.last_comment_by
    FROM `tabGL Entry` gle
    LEFT JOIN `tabJournal Entry` je ON gle.voucher_type = 'Journal Entry' AND je.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON gle.voucher_type = 'Sales Invoice' AND si.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice` pi ON gle.voucher_type = 'Purchase Invoice' AND pi.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry` pe ON gle.voucher_type = 'Payment Entry' AND pe.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` pr ON gle.voucher_type = 'Purchase Receipt' AND pr.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn ON gle.voucher_type = 'Delivery Note' AND dn.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabStock Entry` ste ON gle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' AND ste.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabStock Reconciliation` sr ON gle.voucher_type = 'Stock Reconciliation' AND sr.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabLanded Cost Voucher` lcv ON gle.voucher_type = 'Landed Cost Voucher' AND lcv.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabPeriod Closing Voucher` pcv ON gle.voucher_type = 'Period Closing Voucher' AND pcv.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabExchange Rate Revaluation` err ON gle.voucher_type = 'Exchange Rate Revaluation' AND err.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN `tabSubcontracting Receipt` scr ON gle.voucher_type = 'Subcontracting Receipt' AND scr.name = gle.voucher_no
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT s.*,
        COALESCE(s.submitted_by_v, s.first_gl_by) AS submitted_by,
        COALESCE(s.submitted_on_v, s.first_gl_on) AS submitted_on,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabVersion` ver
          WHERE ver.ref_doctype = s.voucher_type AND ver.docname = s.voucher_no
            AND IFNULL(JSON_CONTAINS(ver.data, '[["docstatus"]]', '$.changed'), 0) = 0
            AND ver.creation < COALESCE(s.submitted_on_v, s.first_gl_on, '9999-12-31')) AS draft_edits,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabVersion` ver
          WHERE ver.ref_doctype = s.voucher_type AND ver.docname = s.voucher_no
            AND IFNULL(JSON_CONTAINS(ver.data, '[["docstatus"]]', '$.changed'), 0) = 0
            AND ver.creation > COALESCE(s.submitted_on_v, s.first_gl_on, '9999-12-31')
            AND ver.creation < COALESCE(s.cancelled_on_v, '9999-12-31')) AS post_submit_edits
      FROM (
        SELECT d.voucher_type, d.voucher_no,
          (SELECT ver.owner FROM `tabVersion` ver WHERE ver.ref_doctype = d.voucher_type AND ver.docname = d.voucher_no
             AND IFNULL(JSON_CONTAINS(ver.data, '[["docstatus",0,1]]', '$.changed'), 0) = 1 ORDER BY ver.creation LIMIT 1) AS submitted_by_v,
          (SELECT ver.creation FROM `tabVersion` ver WHERE ver.ref_doctype = d.voucher_type AND ver.docname = d.voucher_no
             AND IFNULL(JSON_CONTAINS(ver.data, '[["docstatus",0,1]]', '$.changed'), 0) = 1 ORDER BY ver.creation LIMIT 1) AS submitted_on_v,
          (SELECT ver.owner FROM `tabVersion` ver WHERE ver.ref_doctype = d.voucher_type AND ver.docname = d.voucher_no
             AND IFNULL(JSON_CONTAINS(ver.data, '[["docstatus",1,2]]', '$.changed'), 0) = 1 ORDER BY ver.creation LIMIT 1) AS cancelled_by_v,
          (SELECT ver.creation FROM `tabVersion` ver WHERE ver.ref_doctype = d.voucher_type AND ver.docname = d.voucher_no
             AND IFNULL(JSON_CONTAINS(ver.data, '[["docstatus",1,2]]', '$.changed'), 0) = 1 ORDER BY ver.creation LIMIT 1) AS cancelled_on_v,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabVersion` ver WHERE ver.ref_doctype = d.voucher_type AND ver.docname = d.voucher_no) AS version_count,
          (SELECT ver.creation FROM `tabVersion` ver WHERE ver.ref_doctype = d.voucher_type AND ver.docname = d.voucher_no
             ORDER BY ver.creation DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_version_on,
          (SELECT ver.owner FROM `tabVersion` ver WHERE ver.ref_doctype = d.voucher_type AND ver.docname = d.voucher_no
             ORDER BY ver.creation DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_version_by,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabComment` cm WHERE cm.reference_doctype = d.voucher_type AND cm.reference_name = d.voucher_no
             AND cm.comment_type NOT IN ('Like', 'Label')) AS comment_events,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabComment` cm WHERE cm.reference_doctype = d.voucher_type AND cm.reference_name = d.voucher_no
             AND cm.comment_type = 'Comment') AS comment_count,
          (SELECT cm.creation FROM `tabComment` cm WHERE cm.reference_doctype = d.voucher_type AND cm.reference_name = d.voucher_no
             AND cm.comment_type NOT IN ('Like', 'Label') ORDER BY cm.creation DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_comment_on,
          (SELECT cm.owner FROM `tabComment` cm WHERE cm.reference_doctype = d.voucher_type AND cm.reference_name = d.voucher_no
             AND cm.comment_type NOT IN ('Like', 'Label') ORDER BY cm.creation DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_comment_by,
          (SELECT g2.owner FROM `tabGL Entry` g2 WHERE g2.voucher_type = d.voucher_type AND g2.voucher_no = d.voucher_no
             ORDER BY g2.creation LIMIT 1) AS first_gl_by,
          (SELECT g2.creation FROM `tabGL Entry` g2 WHERE g2.voucher_type = d.voucher_type AND g2.voucher_no = d.voucher_no
             ORDER BY g2.creation LIMIT 1) AS first_gl_on
        FROM (
          SELECT DISTINCT gle.voucher_type, gle.voucher_no
          FROM `tabGL Entry` gle
          WHERE gle.company = %(company)s
      AND (%(finance_book)s = '' OR IFNULL(gle.finance_book, '') IN ('', %(finance_book)s))
      AND (%(account)s = '' OR gle.account IN (
            SELECT ca.name FROM `tabAccount` ca, `tabAccount` pa
            WHERE pa.name = %(account)s AND ca.lft >= pa.lft AND ca.rgt <= pa.rgt))
      AND (%(voucher_type)s = '' OR gle.voucher_type = %(voucher_type)s)
      AND (%(voucher_no)s = '' OR gle.voucher_no = %(voucher_no)s)
      AND (%(party_type)s = '' OR gle.party_type = %(party_type)s)
      AND (%(party)s = '' OR gle.party = %(party)s)
      AND (%(cost_center)s = '' OR gle.cost_center IN (
            SELECT cc.name FROM `tabCost Center` cc, `tabCost Center` pc
            WHERE pc.name = %(cost_center)s AND cc.lft >= pc.lft AND cc.rgt <= pc.rgt))
      AND (%(project)s = '' OR gle.project = %(project)s)
      AND (%(show_cancelled_entries)s = 1 OR gle.is_cancelled = 0)
            AND gle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND IFNULL(gle.is_opening, 'No') = 'No'
        ) d
      ) s
    ) va ON va.voucher_type = gle.voucher_type AND va.voucher_no = gle.voucher_no
    WHERE gle.company = %(company)s
      AND (%(finance_book)s = '' OR IFNULL(gle.finance_book, '') IN ('', %(finance_book)s))
      AND (%(account)s = '' OR gle.account IN (
            SELECT ca.name FROM `tabAccount` ca, `tabAccount` pa
            WHERE pa.name = %(account)s AND ca.lft >= pa.lft AND ca.rgt <= pa.rgt))
      AND (%(voucher_type)s = '' OR gle.voucher_type = %(voucher_type)s)
      AND (%(voucher_no)s = '' OR gle.voucher_no = %(voucher_no)s)
      AND (%(party_type)s = '' OR gle.party_type = %(party_type)s)
      AND (%(party)s = '' OR gle.party = %(party)s)
      AND (%(cost_center)s = '' OR gle.cost_center IN (
            SELECT cc.name FROM `tabCost Center` cc, `tabCost Center` pc
            WHERE pc.name = %(cost_center)s AND cc.lft >= pc.lft AND cc.rgt <= pc.rgt))
      AND (%(project)s = '' OR gle.project = %(project)s)
      AND (%(show_cancelled_entries)s = 1 OR gle.is_cancelled = 0)
      AND gle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND IFNULL(gle.is_opening, 'No') = 'No'
  ) x
  WHERE (%(created_by)s = '' OR x.created_by = %(created_by)s)
      AND (%(modified_by)s = '' OR x.modified_by = %(modified_by)s)
      AND (%(submitted_by)s = '' OR (x.docstatus IN (1, 2) AND x.submitted_by = %(submitted_by)s))
      AND (%(modified_from)s = '' OR DATE(x.modified_on) >= %(modified_from)s)
      AND (%(modified_to)s = '' OR DATE(x.modified_on) <= %(modified_to)s)
      AND (%(only_edited_after_submit)s <> 1 OR x.post_submit_edits > 0)

  UNION ALL
  /* 2: period total, 3: closing (values computed by window functions above) */
  SELECT 2 AS seq, NULL AS posting_date, NULL AS gl_creation, NULL AS gl_name, '''Total''' AS account, NULL AS debit, NULL AS credit, NULL AS voucher_type, NULL AS voucher_subtype, NULL AS voucher_no, NULL AS against, NULL AS party_type, NULL AS party, NULL AS cost_center, NULL AS project, NULL AS against_voucher_type, NULL AS against_voucher, NULL AS remarks, NULL AS doc_status, NULL AS created_by, NULL AS created_on, NULL AS modified_by, NULL AS modified_on, NULL AS submitted_by, NULL AS submitted_on, NULL AS cancelled_by, NULL AS cancelled_on, NULL AS gl_posted_by, NULL AS gl_posted_on, NULL AS activity, NULL AS activity_events, NULL AS edits_after_submit, NULL AS last_activity_by, NULL AS last_activity_on
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3 AS seq, NULL AS posting_date, NULL AS gl_creation, NULL AS gl_name, '''Closing (Opening + Total)''' AS account, NULL AS debit, NULL AS credit, NULL AS voucher_type, NULL AS voucher_subtype, NULL AS voucher_no, NULL AS against, NULL AS party_type, NULL AS party, NULL AS cost_center, NULL AS project, NULL AS against_voucher_type, NULL AS against_voucher, NULL AS remarks, NULL AS doc_status, NULL AS created_by, NULL AS created_on, NULL AS modified_by, NULL AS modified_on, NULL AS submitted_by, NULL AS submitted_on, NULL AS cancelled_by, NULL AS cancelled_on, NULL AS gl_posted_by, NULL AS gl_posted_on, NULL AS activity, NULL AS activity_events, NULL AS edits_after_submit, NULL AS last_activity_by, NULL AS last_activity_on
) t
ORDER BY t.seq, t.posting_date, t.gl_creation, t.gl_name
